# temps_environment_domain (Resource)

A domain an environment answers on. Point its DNS at Temps; Temps obtains the certificate. Use `temps_custom_domain` for domains with redirects or per-domain settings.

Import with `<project_id>/<environment_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `environments:read`, `environments:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_environment_domain" "staging" {
  project_id     = temps_project.web.id
  environment_id = temps_environment.staging.id
  domain         = "staging.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name, for example `staging.example.com`.
- `environment_id` (Number) ID of the environment.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `is_primary` (Boolean) Make it the environment's primary domain. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<environment_id>/<id>`.
- `url` (String) URL the environment serves on this domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<environment_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_environment_domain.staging 8/21/4
```
